title: Lighthouse runtime preflight & triage notes (draft)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working draft for a compact preflight & first-responder triage checklist we can drop into private (VPC/on-prem) installs. The goal is a small, high-signal set of checks and remediation steps operators can run during installs, upgrades, or first-hour incidents. Think: light, pragmatic, cluster-and-host focused — not a full SRE runbook.

Status/Intent:
- Draft for engineering/field-eng review.
- Meant to be pasted into support tickets and used by the on-call first responder.
- Includes quick terraform notes where module quirks often cause failure.

Quick summary (1-line):
Run preflight, validate control-plane certs, confirm network routes & MTU, ensure GPU drivers match runtime, check container runtime health, peek at kv-cache and model-server logs, then run the smoke generator. If any step fails, follow the per-section remediation below.

Checklist (order matters):
1) Run preflight script (local): ./scripts/lighthouse-preflight.sh --target <cluster> --quick
   - Expected exit: 0
   - Key checks: DNS resolution for control plane, required ports open, NTP sync, KMS reachability.
   - Typical failures: DNS returning 127.0.0.1 for internal endpoints (cause: /etc/hosts override), MTU mismatch on transit link.

2) Terraform sanity (operator):
   - terraform workspace list && terraform plan -target=module.k8s_cluster
   - Check state drift: terraform state list | grep aws_vpc
   - Notes: module 'networking' may create duplicate route tables if apply interrupted mid-attach. Workaround: import the route table resource or run terraform state rm for the stray transient resource then reapply.
   - Common var mismatches: cidr_block vs transit_cidr, overlapping security_group rules (SSH allowed from 0.0.0.0/0).

3) Control plane TLS / certs:
   - Command: openssl s_client -connect controlplane:6443 -showcerts
   - Check expiry, CN/SANs include expected hostnames, chain is complete.
   - Failure patterns: CSR not signed during bootstrap (reason: controller-manager pods failing to access KMS).

4) Time & clock skew:
   - Commands: timedatectl status; chronyc tracking (or ntpq -p)
   - Threshold: < 200ms drift within cluster nodes.
   - If > 500ms: stop services that do mTLS until clocks fixed (e.g., sidecars) then restart.

5) Networking & MTU checks:
   - Quick tests: ping -M do -s 1400 <peer-ip>; ip link show; tracepath <peer-ip>
   - Symptoms of MTU issues: TLS handshake stalls, large protobufs failing, intermittent gRPC timeouts at ~4KB payloads.
   - Fix: align MTU on host OS and CNI; set DOCKER_OPTS / containerd extra_args to respect host MTU when present.

6) Container runtime / CRI health:
   - systemctl is-active containerd / docker; crictl ps -a | head
   - Logs: journalctl -u containerd -n 200
   - Failure patterns: image pull failures due to overlayfs ENOSPC, or CRI OOMs due to cgroup driver mismatch (systemd vs cgroupfs).

7) GPU / driver validation (if applicable):
   - nvidia-smi; nvidia-container-cli --load-kmods info
   - Check CUDA driver + runtime compatibility table (see linked PR).
   - Common issue: driver present but plugin (device-plugin) failing because kubelet lacks --feature-gates for device-plugins on older versions.

8) KV-cache / model-server quick sanity:
   - kubectl -n redwood get pods -o wide | grep model
   - kubectl logs <model-pod> -c model-server --tail=200 | egrep "ERROR|WARN" | head -n 80
   - Check for: repeated OOMKilled, persistent 429 bursts, 'kv cache miss flood' messages.

9) Local smoke generator run (golden path):
   - curl -X POST https://<svc>/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"smoke-test: hello"}' --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15
   - Expect: 200, tokens stream, < 1s latency for small prompts under dedicated capacity.
   - If streaming fails but non-streaming returns OK: check websocket/proxy (nginx/envoy) config.

10) Observability & telemetry quick-hits:
   - Confirm metrics ingestion: grafana/datasource OK, last datapoint for redwood.request.latency within 2min.
   - Quick queries: (promql) rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) > 0; sum(irate(node_cpu_seconds_total[1m])) to catch overloaded hosts.

Failure fingerprints (common root causes and first-line remediation):
- DNS resolution to internal registry fails -> workaround: add registry IP to /etc/hosts on bootstrap host; long-term fix: update Coredns configmap and restart coredns.
- Terraform apply hangs on ENI attach -> check VPC quotas, detach stale ENIs in console; re-run terraform apply after manual cleanup.
- Model-pod OOMs after upgrade -> reduce model batch_size / memory_limit in modelServer config and restart.
- KMS/HSM auth failures -> verify IAM role/key policy and KMS endpoint network egress.
- Persistent node CPU steal / kernel soft lockups -> check bios/power settings and hyperthreading; escalate to infra.

Upgrade-specific notes:
- Canary deploy plan: pick 1 node pool with 2-3 replicas, annotate deployment with rollout: canary, route 5% traffic for 15m, monitor latency and error rate.
- Rollback: use image tag rollback (not config) unless schema changed; avoid mixing old/new kv-cache schemas.
- Terraform upgrades: pin provider version in terraform.lock; run terraform plan with -out and review resource replacements carefully.

Terraform module quirks observed (notes):
- module.networking: subnet creation has a conditional that sometimes returns stable=false during a state refresh if the cloud API returns transient tags. Add a small sleep in the apply wrapper for busy clouds.
- module.k8s_cluster: kubelet_tls_bootstrap toggle defaults to true; if customer uses an internal CA path we must flip this off — documented in template variables but often missed.

Quick commands cheat-sheet (copy-paste):
- Check k8s control plane: kubectl get componentstatuses; kubectl get cs | grep -v Healthy
- Restart model server container: kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/model-server --field-selector metadata.name=model-server
- Dump kubelet journal across nodes (via ssh loop): for n in $(cat nodes.txt); do ssh $n sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 | tail -n 200; done

Outstanding TODOs / questions:
- Add small preflight that validates KMS HSM rounding/truncation behavior for cert signing (Diego to prototype).
- Decide on default MTU for VIP overlays across cloud partners (Lin to confirm with infra partners).
- Add example Prometheus queries for kv-cache tail-failure rate and a sample Grafana alert threshold.

Notes to support/field teams (tone):
This is intentionally terse. If you keep hitting repeated failures during install, capture: preflight output, terraform plan -out, kubelet and model-server logs, plus the exact smoke curl output. Attach these to the ticket and ping eng-private-deployments on Slack with CON-2247 in subject.

Changelog (draft):
- 2025-02-11 A.Patel initial draft
- 2025-02-20 D.Morales added TF quirks and GPU notes
- 2025-03-05 L.Chen added MTU test and observability quick-hits

References:

- Confluence: Private Deployments Observability Runbooks (link above)
- Related tickets: JIRA INF-2247

End of draft.
